parsed.why: No trans-specific offence and third-gender tradition, but provincial trans people face documented discrimination, physical and sexual harassment with thin recourse, plus rising political homophobia and death threats. Resident recognition gaps don't reach visitors.

Protected facility access, GI hate-crime aggravators, care lawful; no visitor-facing restriction. Rollback bills passed only first reading, so unresolved, not operative; high public support, thriving pride infrastructure.
